listen_addr.description: IP address the policy daemon listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Port number for incoming connections from Postfix.

max_children.description: Maximum number of worker processes (concurrent connections) to spawn.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to '-' to log to stdout.

log_syslog.description: Whether to also log to syslog in addition to file.

chroot.description: Whether to chroot the daemon for security isolation.

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon's process ID (PID) file.

connection_timeout.description: Maximum idle time (in seconds) before a connection is closed.

use_dns.description: Enable DNS lookups (required for SPF, DNSBL, and HELO checks).

dns_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a DNS response.

rate_limit_interval.description: Time window (in seconds) over which connections are counted for rate limiting.

max_connections_per_source.description: Maximum connections allowed per source IP within rate_limit_interval.

check_helo.description: Check HELO/EHLO hostname reputation (e.g., IP vs hostname match).

check_sender.description: Check sender domain reputation and format.

use_greylist.description: Enable greylisting: temporarily reject first-time senders.

greylist_delay.description: Minimum delay (in seconds) before accepting a retried connection.

greylist_expiry.description: Time (in seconds) after which a greylisted entry is removed.

greylist_db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database storing greylisting entries.

dnsbl_conf.description: Path to the DNSBL configuration file (host,rcode,reason format).

spf_conf.description: Path to optional SPF rules file.

helo_conf.description: Path to optional HELO rules file.

sender_conf.description: Path to optional sender rules file.

client_ip_conf.description: Path to optional client IP rules file.

permitted_senders.description: List of domains or IPs that are exempt from all checks (e.g., internal mail servers).

items.description: Domain or IP address allowed to bypass policy checks.

permitted_clients.description: List of client IPs exempt from rate limiting and greylisting.

items.description: IP address or CIDR subnet exempt from rate limiting.

weight_rules.description: List of weight adjustment rules. Each rule adds or subtracts from the sender’s score.

description.description: Detailed description for documentation (used in comment).
